title: Everglades Eco-Adventure Tour
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
EXPERIENCE THE BEST EVERGLADES TOUR IN MIAMI

Experience the best Everglades Tour! During this exciting tour, you’ll journey through the world-famous Florida’s Everglades Park on a guided shared 60-minute airboat tour, where you’re likely to see alligators, crocodiles and other exotic wildlife. 

After the 60-minute airboat tour, you’ll attend a 20-minute alligator wildlife show before traveling back to Miami.

You will spend about 2 hours at the park before returning back to Miami. The entire experience including the round-trip transportation is 4-4.5 hours (depending on traffic).

---

Hotel Pick-up Details

The pick-up times are between 7:20 AM - 8:15 AM. The exact pick-up location and time will be assigned the day before your tour around 5:00 PM.

If you're staying outside of our pick-up area, please select the nearest pick-up location, or give us a call at 305-639-8395 to better coordinate.
